name: Updating an Element in the List (Case 1)
description: Construct a program that initializes a list with three values, changes the first element in the list, and finally, prints the list.
code:
#Step 1: Define a list of three integer values
lst = [123, 100, 39]
#Step 2: Update the list element
lst[0] = 2
#Step 3: Print the list
print(lst)

1.content: #Step 1: Define a list of three integer values

commentList: We want to assign three values to the list. In this statement, we define the list referred by variable lst to hold three integer values. We initialize the list by separating elements with a comma and enclosing the collection in square brackets [ ].
This statement updates the first element of the list to the integer value 2.

To update an element in the list, we need to give the square bracket slice operator ([ ] ) along with an index of the element that we want to update on the left-hand side of the assignment operator. The index could start at 0 and continue up to but not including the length of the list. The value on the right-hand side of the assignment operator is the new value that we want to assign to the list element.
We can see the content of the list by calling the print function and passing the list to that. This statement prints the list.
